UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information within the NuxusChat application, enabling personalized interactions and identification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

name.description: The full display name of the user.

username.description: A unique public identifier for the user, typically starting with '@'. Used for search and direct mentions.

phone.description: The user's phone number, used as a unique contact identifier for registration and login.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

lastSeen.description: ISO timestamp of the last time the user was active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: Represents a conversation, which can be a private direct message, a multi-user group, or a broadcast channel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Chat entity.

type.description: The classification of the chat, either 'private', 'group', or 'channel'.

name.description: The display name of the chat (e.g., group name, channel name, or inferred from the other participant's name for private chats).

username.description: A unique public identifier for group or channel chats, starting with '@'. Used for join links and search.

description.description: A descriptive text providing information about the channel or group.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the chat's avatar image, applicable for group and channel chats.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the chat was created.

ownerId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who initially created and owns this group or channel.

participantIds.description: References to UserProfile IDs who are active participants in this chat.

adminIds.description: References to UserProfile IDs who have administrative privileges within this group or channel chat.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single communication message sent within any chat, supporting various content types and Telegram-like features.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

chatId.description: Reference to the Chat in which this message was sent.

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID who sent this message.

senderName.description: Cached sender name for display performance.

content.description: The textual content or media URL.

sentAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

replyToId.description: Reference to another Message ID if this is a reply.

replyToContent.description: Snippet of the replied message content for display.

editedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was last edited.

isRead.description: Whether the message has been seen by participants.

definition.description: Stores metadata for all conversation types.
Stores individual messages for a specific chat.
